maddeler.e:
نمتثل (form VIII)
# نَمْتَثِلُ (namtaṯilu) /nam.ta.θi.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
# نُمْتَثَلُ (numtaṯalu) /num.ta.θa.lu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
# نَمْتَثِلَ (namtaṯila) /nam.ta.θi.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
# نُمْتَثَلَ (numtaṯala) /num.ta.θa.la/:
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
